sections.description: Selective WordPress push and pull migrations controlled from either site. Transfer selected database tables, plugins, themes and media using verified streams, with destination rollback and cascading media comparison.
sections.changelog:
0.1.17

  • Redesign migration setup with a component rail, comparison workspace and persistent selection summary.
  • Add a navy telemetry view with measured transfer metrics, verification pipeline and visible recent activity.
  • Keep stage timers inline and normalize successful replacement/health progress.
  • Keep the current site first and point the arrow toward the push or pull destination.
  • Improve responsive layouts and keyboard-visible selection states.

0.1.16

  • Require authenticated requests on dedicated entry points before isolating plugins; prevent request fields from disabling security plugins on unrelated pages and automatically refresh older recovery loaders after upgrading.
  • Keep staging and backup storage outside the public document root, including public symlink paths.
  • Add Settings and Diagnostics tabs, searchable component lists and editable migration presets.
  • Combine transfer and verification views with interactive byte/speed charts, stage timers, Follow live and visible retry/error activity.
  • Collapse setup during transfers and show completion receipts with direct destination-backup links.
  • Use explicit destination actions and keep site versions inside source/destination panels.

0.1.15

  • Default to continuous resumable downloads for pulls and signed 16 MiB upload windows for pushes.
  • Declare upload Content-Length to avoid sending a full large snapshot in one POST.
  • Retain byte-offset recovery and complete snapshot verification before staging or replacement.
  • Keep 512 KB chunks available as an explicit alternative.
  • Use normal plugin user agents in migration tests; remove agent-identity overrides.

0.1.14

  • Use continuous streaming with durable byte-offset resume and complete snapshot verification; keep 512 KB chunks available.
  • Skip matching media by default through cascading year/month/file checksums; add explicit forced retransfer.
  • Preserve matching plugin/theme folder skips in mixed selections and large comparison plans.
  • Recover transient connection failures and busy source preparation with separate bounded retries; never replay application blindly.
  • Preserve the full active plugin list when upgrading older recovery loaders.
  • Show PHP compatibility notices with the component name, destination PHP version, file and line.
  • Fix primary-key discovery and compound-key ordering on MariaDB.

0.1.13

  • Speed repeat pulls with compact matching-component plans and smaller checkpoint responses.
  • Remove redundant remote progress polls after pull snapshots are ready.
  • Show component sizes, transfer progress, elapsed time, a live ETA and recent activity.
  • Prepare source streams before sending and resume verified checkpoints.
  • Allow authenticated pushes and pulls by default on fresh installs, preserving saved permissions.

0.1.12

  • Add agent-oriented CLI presets for database refreshes, missing plugins and version-controlled code pushes.
  • Add read-only selection plans, automatic Git folder discovery and structured workflow results.

0.1.11

  • Copy the source active plugin list by default for every push or pull, including partial transfers.
  • Add an explicit option to preserve destination activation, and restore previous activation during recovery.

0.1.10

  • Run staging and replacement from one Push or Pull action.
  • Retain three destination backups with a separate restore page.
  • Resume interrupted network transfers and recover failed replacements automatically.

0.1.9

  • Require matching Trickle versions before preparing, transferring or applying migrations.
  • Update remote Trickle from the controlling site through the configured JSON feed, with separate permission and package validation.

0.1.8

  • Protect Git working directories and always exclude environment files, Git metadata, .gitignore and node_modules.
  • Add incremental plugin/theme transfers, paginated file-change previews and pre-apply checks.
  • Resume checksummed 512 KB network segments using retained source streams.
  • Add temporary apply maintenance and automatic rollback on frontend HTTP 5xx.
  • Handle HTTP/HTTPS/protocol-relative and JSON-escaped URL replacements.
  • Add named, expiring, separately revocable connection keys.

0.1.7

  • Enable Plugin Update Checker with a static JSON feed, matching the Guest Key update method.
  • Register update checks in dashboard, cron, AJAX, REST and WP-CLI requests.
  • Use versioned GitHub release ZIPs and identify the custom update source to WordPress.

0.1.6

  • Add cached year, month and file comparisons for changed or missing media, with push, pull and rollback support.
